note: The game scripts AmiWind carries with its own code instead of running them (config/mwscript.json handwritten), each with its counterpart and a step-by-step parity check against the script. tools/mwscript_features.py renders it into docs/MWSCRIPT_FEATURES.md; tests/test_mwscript_counterparts.py refuses an entry without a counterpart or a verdict, and a carried script without an entry. Decided for the project, 9 November 2026: the opening from the prison ship to the census office is AmiWind's own implementation.
